subject: Error when running PCoA using distance matrix as input - gl.pcoa()

messages.author: 04e71feb5b4997db
messages.subject: Error when running PCoA using distance matrix as input - gl.pcoa()
parts:
Hey everyone,

I'm trying to run a PCoA with the line of code below (distance matrix from dist() function in base R package as input):

pcoa <- gl.pcoa(dist)

But for some reason I am getting this error I have never gotten before:

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable) :
unable to find an inherited method for function ‘nInd’ for signature ‘"dist"’

Does anyone know what this means or how to fix it?

Much thanks!
Dallas
